caption: The drawing depicts a small, round jar with a single handle attached to its side, positioned to the viewer’s right. The jar is placed on a horizontal, wood-textured surface. The vessel has a wide body that tapers towards the neck, then slightly flares out at the mouth. Its color is a warm, earthy brown with darker and lighter streaks and spots, giving it a natural, glazed ceramic appearance. The single handle is arched and attached at the rim and upper body. Above the jar, there is text that reads: "SMALL JAR WITH HANDLE" and beneath that, "EARLY 19th CENTURY." The background is plain and cream-colored, and the entire drawing appears to be carefully rendered to show the jar’s three-dimensional form and surface details.
title: Bean Pot
